title: Migraine Around Your Period? How Much Can a Seven-Day Prevention Strategy Help?
author: 藥時事 Drugnews
summary: The days around menstruation can already be uncomfortable. Add migraine, sensitivity to light or nausea, and work, school pickups and carefully planned activities can be disrupted. For people whose attacks repeatedly cluster in this window, the question is straightforward: can the burden be reduced before the headache arrives?
cover_image_alt: A woman and calendar identify the risk window around menstruation; the seven-day preventive study regimen connects to migraine diaries and daily-function assessments.
